EARTH.glyph: A broad solid bar lies horizontally across the lower third, thick and flat-ended, the weight of soil and stone underfoot and the foundation that does not move. Beneath it, four short vertical bars descend at even spacing, slightly thinning as they go, roots of patience reaching down and away. Above the bar's centre rests a hollow closed circle, drawn with a heavy line, sitting directly on the bar and touching it: the buried seed, held and enclosed. Inside that circle, offset low, sits one small solid dot, the dreaming that keeps still at the centre of the world. From the top of the hollow circle a single thin line rises a short way and ends bluntly, going nowhere: the seed's refusal to surface. To the right, well apart from all of this, three thin parallel horizontal strokes stack evenly, shorter than the bar, quiet and level: the stillness that stands off from the mass.

WATER.glyph: A large open circle sits slightly left of centre, its stroke swelling thick at the bottom and thinning to a hair at the top: a hollow vessel that holds and reflects, heavy where depth gathers. Inside it, a smaller filled disc rests low and off-centre, a still dense core that the hollow surrounds without touching. Below the circle, three parallel wavy lines run horizontally, each shorter than the last and each ending free in space: the tide moving out and thinning away. From the top of the circle a single straight line rises, breaks into two short segments separated by a gap, then stops: rain that does not arrive. To the right, a long thin curve sweeps down from the upper right and bends away from the circle, never joining it, its weight constant: the flowing that leaves and does not return. A single small dot sits in the gap between circle and curve, held apart from both.

FIRE.glyph: A tall narrow solid black wedge stands at the centre, widest at its base and tapering to a sharp point above the middle: the core of transformation and restless hunger, dense and closed. Around its base three thin open curves nest in parallel, each slightly wider than the last, hugging the wedge without touching it: the hearth glow and the heat that gathers but stays contained. From the wedge's point a single thin line rises straight and then frays into four short strokes that lean and scatter outward at uneven lengths: smoke rising and sparks flung loose. On the left side, apart from the wedge, a small filled dot sits with two short parallel bars angled beneath it, the steady tending that feeds without flaring. On the right, a jagged broken line of three sharp angles cuts inward toward the wedge and stops short of it, the sudden flare that never quite lands. The whole composition tilts slightly left, the balance of a thing that leans toward what feeds it.

AIR.glyph: Three long parallel horizontal strokes of uneven weight stack in the upper half, each broken by a gap in a different place so the gaps drift left, centre, right: the moving medium, invisible and continuous yet interrupted, the whisper and the gust. Below them, one thin stroke curves up and away toward the upper right, thinning to a point as it leaves the field: lifting and weightless, what rises out of the flow. At the lower left a small hollow circle sits alone, unfilled, the open space the strokes pass over without touching. From the right end of the lowest bar, four short strokes fan out and shorten as they spread: scattering seeds carried off. The whole composition is open at the top and sides, no enclosing line, so nothing is held in.
